_doc: c033 BODY-ONLY in the moving showroom: the measured scene. Units: metres, pixels at 1080x1920. Camera frame: X right, depth forward, height up from the floor. Every value is labelled MEASURED (from the files), SPEC (manufacturer figure), ESTIMATE (assumption, with what it rests on) or DECISION.
_room_scale: DECISION (Fendi, 19 Oct: 'scale the penguin and objects down or scale me up in a natural manner'): the room is 5 % smaller than the standard-counter reading, so the island top is 0.865 m (34 in), the penguin 1.21 m (a large emperor) and the camera 1.65 m high. The plate's picture is unchanged; only his size against it moves

plate._fps: DECISION: the 24 fps Kling plate is motion-interpolated to the shot's 59.94 (ffmpeg minterpolate mci/aobmc/bidir, filed in AVT) so snow, penguin and train do not judder against his 59.94 frames
plate._start: DECISION: plate 0.95-4.94 s, so the train and the light sweep land in the shot's last 2 s
plate._focal: MEASURED from the island top's two vanishing points (1626,792) and (-1716,792), orthogonal
plate._horizon: MEASURED: island and kitchen-wall vanishing lines; every vertical in the still is within 0.2 deg of vertical, so pitch 0 and roll 0 (MEASURED) and the horizon sits above centre (lens shift)
plate._height: ESTIMATE: from a 0.91 m island top (standard counter, ASSUMED) and the island's floor line; cross-checked by the penguin reading 1.27 m tall at 5.76 m
plate.motion: MEASURED locked-off: under 0.3 px drift at 540 px wide over 121 frames

room_v5._doc: The room moves without generative video (Fendi, 19 Oct: the Kling motion 'looks AI generated and antithetical to our whole approach'). The still is split into layers (room_layers.py); Blender renders the snow; room_motion.py moves the branches, the penguin and the LED light by fixed curves. Pixel values are at the still's 1584x2816 unless named _1080.
room_v5._car_depth: MEASURED: the SUV's wheel line in the original still, the same value the scene's car proxy uses
room_v5._car_spec: SPEC: Ferrari Purosangue height 1,589 mm. The pasted car read 1.93 m at the car's depth (Fendi, 19 Oct: 'the Ferrari appear to be larger than the other truck'), the SUV it replaced 1.97 m
room_v5._car_proxy: the scene's car card (x from, x to, height, metres at 10.6 m) shrunk with the car: 0.828 about its anchor's X 1.44 m (the scale room_layers.py prints)
room_v5._car_anchor: DECISION: the car shrinks about its front wheel's ground point (x MEASURED on the still, y the ground line at the car's depth), so it stays parked on the same spot
room_v5._lamps: MEASURED on the shrunk car at 1080x1920: the two LED strips and the two lower lamps (DRL right/left, lamp right/left), each with ~8 px for its glow
room_v5._flakes: DECISION: the still's painted snowflakes (dots under 40 px over dark sky) are removed so the only snow that moves is Blender's

wind._: DECISION: one wind for the whole yard, strength 0.38-1.12 of its mean over the shot (a slow gust every ~3 s and a quicker flutter); the snow and the branches both follow it

snow._probe: MEASURED with --probe (5000 flakes): fall 1.11 m/s and drift 1.11 m/s (medians); the wind field is a flow (drag toward the wind), so gravity 0.047 balances it at the fall speed
snow._: ESTIMATE/DECISION: snowflakes ~2.4 cm falling ~1 m/s (typical light snow), between the glass (15.5 m, MEASURED from the window's floor line) and the far trees; a half-frame shutter streaks them like the phone would; colour from the still's painted flakes

trees._: DECISION: the branches move up to 1.4 px (at 1080 wide; the trees are 25 m or more away) with the wind's gusts, more toward the crowns, none at the snowy ground (y 968 at 1080, MEASURED floor line of the glass), the frames or the mullions

led._: ESTIMATE/DECISION: a phone reads its sensor rows over ~13 ms per frame (~6.8 us a row at 1920 rows); LED lamps driven at ~1.62 kHz PWM span ~90 rows per on/off cycle, so a lamp 40-60 rows tall carries about half a dark band. 1.62 kHz is 27.03 cycles per 59.94 fps frame, so the bands crawl 0.03 cycle (2.7 rows) a frame. Depth 0.55 is the share of light the band takes out at its darkest (an exposure longer than the PWM period softens it)

penguin_motion._enabled: DECISION (Fendi, 20 Oct, on the walking penguin: 'That looks terrible … Remove the penguin from the scene altogether … It looks AI generated and cheesy'): no penguin; the clean still (b30bd9e2) shows the cabinets and floor where it stood. The tracks below are kept only as a record
penguin_motion._: DECISION (Fendi, 20 Oct: 'Not enough movement still, the penguin doesn't have to stand still, it can walk away from me in a natural movement'): its own pixels, mirrored to face its path, never redrawn. It looks over its shoulder (a short turn) for 0.7 s, then waddles away from him along the floor in front of the cabinets at its measured depth (5.76 m, room metric unscaled), toward frame-left: 0.3 m/s (a brisk emperor-penguin pace) in 0.5 s steps, rocking 8 deg about the stance foot with a 2 px bob, flipper held out 16 deg for balance. Its ground point follows the measured camera, so it scales with perspective. Feet, neck, flipper box and shoulder MEASURED on the still at 1080x1920

room_v5._glass: MEASURED on a pixel grid of the clean still: the window wall, the two clerestory panes above the kitchen, the mullions (dark columns) and the transom (dark rows)

island._: corners MEASURED in the image (252,1160) and (959,1292) and lifted with the camera above; length ESTIMATE (it leaves the frame)

penguin._: MEASURED in the image, lifted with the camera

source.camera: SPEC iPhone 14, 4K 59.94, main lens; locked-off (MEASURED, under 0.3 px drift)
source._roll: MEASURED: four door/frame verticals lean -0.96..-1.56 deg the same way; corrected by rotating the take +1.23 deg (geometry only)
source._ppm: ESTIMATE, anchored on Fendi's stated height 6 ft 3 in (1.905 m, 19 Oct): outer eye corners 110.6 px (MEASURED median of 28 frames) over 0.095 m, and eyes-to-waistband 809 px (MEASURED) over ~0.70 m, agree within 1 %. First pass used 1229 (a 0.090 m assumption, 1.80 m man): he read short
source._shorizon: MEASURED level phone (verticals parallel), no lens shift
source._eye: From Fendi's stated height 1.905 m (eyes ~0.125 m below the top of the head); sets how far his head rises above the counter
source._below: the take's camera sat (horizon_y - eye_y) / px_per_metre = 0.245 m below his eyes (MEASURED ratio)

performer._: DECISION: he stands behind the island's far long edge, 0.22 m from it (body centre; his front ~0.1 m off the stone), 1.2 m along it from the far-left corner, so the counter runs across his whole width and the penguin keeps ~1.6 m of floor between them. The take is framed thighs-up, so the island must hide him below the hips.

light._wp: MEASURED: the penguin's white belly, median over the plate
light._ws: MEASURED: the white door beside him in the take
light._exposure: DECISION (checked on the face close-up at 0 / 0.5 / 0.8 / 1.1): the penguin is the white reference but stands away from the downlights, while he stands ~1 m from one; at 0 his face did not read. +0.8 makes eyes, glasses and mouth readable and keeps the jacket at the lit marble's brightness, so he does not glow
light._top: DECISION: the nearest downlight is ~1 m in front of him and ~1.2 m above his head, so his head is lit more than his waist: +0.15 stop at the head, -0.35 stop at the counter
light._flash: DECISION: he takes 80 % of the room's light changes, measured frame by frame on the lit marble backsplash (a fixed surface; the penguin walks in the Ferrari plate). The white balance above stays the penguin belly on the still

tight._: DECISION: the matched camera with a 1.6x lens (47 mm equivalent), framed on him: an exact crop of the wide, so placement and perspective are unchanged and his face reads ~1.6x larger

lens._wrap: DECISION (Fendi, 20 Oct: 'there is bleed I believe from the headlight effect, it looks like I'm coming out of the environment'): the composite lane's 0.5 screen wrap of the blurred room left a pale rim on his outline against the snowy window and carried the Ferrari lamps' rolling band onto his car-side edge; 0.15 keeps the edge in the room's light without the halo (checked at 0.5 / 0.15 / 0 on frames 60, 120, 180)
lens._soft: DECISION: his 4K-derived pixels are crisper than the 1080 AI plate; a 0.5 px lens softness puts him in the same camera (optics, not a redraw)
lens._: DECISION: depth of field from the scene depth, focused on him; 1-4 px of blur on the island and the room

reflection._: DECISION: polished stone at a ~12 deg grazing view
